s: April 9, 2025 - A study by Vineet Kumar of Harvard Business School found that when Nintendo used mixed bundling—which allows customers to purchase products as a bundle (at a discounted price) or individually—to market video game units, sales of these units went up by 100,000 and video game sales increased by more than a million.
